title: DraftKings offers $200 betting bonus for new users
seoTitle: DraftKings offers $200 betting bonus for new users
subtitle: The sports betting platform is booming with a special welcome offer for MLB and college football games.
excerpt: DraftKings is trending with a $200 betting bonus promotion for new customers. Deposit $5 and bet on MLB or college football.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: Crossing Broad, Sports Illustrated, CBS Sports
contentHtml:
The DraftKings sports betting platform has become one of the most searched topics online, driven by a promotional offer that attracts new users. The company is offering a $200 betting bonus to customers who sign up and place an initial wager of at least $5, taking advantage of the schedule of major Major League Baseball (MLB) games and the start of the college football season.

DraftKings welcome promotion

The DraftKings welcome offer is aimed exclusively at new customers. To participate, you must create an account and place a first bet of at least $5 on any available game, such as MLB contests or Week 1 college football matchups. The promotion guarantees a $200 betting bonus regardless of the outcome of the user’s initial wager.

This bonus is seen as a way to build confidence and provide extra capital for new bettors, allowing them to explore different bet types without using their own money right away.

How the bonus is awarded

The $200 bonus is not delivered all at once. It is distributed over 21 days in $25 betting‑bonus increments. Users receive two $25 bonuses every seven days until the total $200 is reached. Note that each batch of betting bonuses expires seven days after being credited to the user’s account, encouraging active participation on the platform.

Activating this welcome offer usually does not require a specific promo code; it is applied automatically once the qualification requirements are met.

Featured sporting events

The promotion runs during a busy stretch of the sports calendar. In MLB, games such as the Philadelphia Phillies vs. Arizona Diamondbacks, Chicago Cubs vs. Milwaukee Brewers, New York Yankees vs. Los Angeles Angels, and Baltimore Orioles vs. Colorado Rockies are cited as betting options. The Phillies‑Diamondbacks matchup, for example, is scheduled for August 31, 2026, with the Phillies favored to win, boasting a 39‑30 away record this season.

In college football, Week 1 includes marquee matchups like Clemson at LSU, Boise State vs. Oregon, and Texas vs. Texas State. Texas, for instance, is favored by 30.5 points over Texas State according to DraftKings’ latest odds.

Availability and responsible gaming

The DraftKings promotion is available to new customers in many U.S. states, including Arizona, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia, Iowa, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Maryland, Maine, Michigan, North Carolina, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Virginia, Vermont, West Virginia, and Wyoming. The offer is not valid in Ontario, Canada.

DraftKings also emphasizes its commitment to responsible gaming. The platform features a dedicated “Responsible Gaming” section with tools that let users set deposit limits, betting limits, and app‑usage time limits. Additionally, the company provides 24/7 support via live chat and lists contact information for state and national help lines for those needing extra assistance, such as 1‑800‑GAMBLER or 1‑800‑MY‑RESET.

Information sourced from Crossing Broad, Sports Illustrated, CBS Sports.
